tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because it is pure Rust and avoids the complexity of C bindings. Related recorded decisions are that HTTPS is enforced everywhere with no plaintext exception for any service, and that certificate verification stays on for all builds.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

The paragraph also carries two related recorded decisions. HTTPS is enforced everywhere with no plaintext exception for any service, and certificate verification stays on for all builds.

One thing you might trip over: a session transcript from earlier in the project has the user saying plain http is fine for internal services behind the firewall. It is only an episode. The later recorded decision, #34, says no plaintext exception for any service, so I followed that. The file was written without running any tests or a build.
